name: EMBA 5722
title: Employment Law
description: Critical components of employment law and how management practices can generate a workplace regulatory environment that is not only compliant, but also a source of value for the firm. Regulatory issues related hiring, firing, and evaluating employees, illegal discrimination, and the rights of and obligations toward vulnerable populations. Additional emphasis is placed on interactions with administrative agencies, protecting firm knowledge from competition, developing employer-employee relationships, managing workplace safety, and resolving disputes.
requirement_description: Open only to Executive MBA students.
